scope: Deliver the shared Adaptive Contrast and Acrylic Glass panel shortcut fixes with the Golden Gate preset.

checks.command: Passed the Golden Gate bootstrap, local update, and release update suites.
Installed the Golden Gate candidate in KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1. Verified that Plasma loaded the newly built native module and showed a consistent menu bar palette with Adaptive Contrast on and off.
Verified the published Tahoe v0.83.1 release and tag, the immutable archive SHA-256, the staged Golden Gate defaults and both fixed Settings and Acrylic Glass files.
Reused shared Tahoe qualification for the isolated brush click, native editor, and KWin 6.6, 6.7, and 6.8 checks.

coverage_limits: Golden Gate desktop rendering used KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 on Wayland. The original v0.82.15 end-to-end migration was not replayed.
